headline: 2 DGFI members dismissed and jailed for one year in Mohammadpur extortion case
summary: Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman were court-martialed after being arrested for an alleged extortion attempt and assault on a businessman. Their dismissal and sentencing follow the proven allegations.
details: Two members of the Directorate General of Forces Intelligence (DGFI) have been dismissed from service and sentenced to one year in prison each. This follows a court martial over an alleged extortion attempt and assault on a businessman in Dhaka's Mohammadpur.
The convicts, Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman, were found guilty of the charges during the court martial proceedings, according to intelligence sources.

They were among six people arrested by police on October 25 after motorcycle trader Mohammad Sharif was allegedly confined in a flat in Chandrima Model Town, Mohammadpur. The group reportedly demanded Tk 10 lakh from him.
Sharif had gone to the flat with an Ansar member, who had offered to help him buy a motorcycle. He was assaulted and forced to hand over Tk 70,000 he had brought for the purchase.

Around 3:00 AM on October 25, Sharif was allegedly taken out of the flat and forced into a car. He managed to inform a police patrol vehicle near Shishu Hospital in Shyamoli, leading to the arrest of the six individuals and seizure of the car.

After being arrested in the case filed by the businessman with Mohammadpur Police Station, the two DGFI personnel were handed over to the army. They were subsequently tried under military law, resulting in their dismissal and imprisonment.

They were among six people arrested by police on October 25 after motorcycle trader Mohammad Sharif was allegedly confined in a flat in Chandrima Model Town, Mohammadpur. The group reportedly demanded Tk 10 lakh from him.

Sharif had gone to the flat with an Ansar member, who had offered to help him buy a motorcycle. He was assaulted and forced to hand over Tk 70,000 he had brought for the purchase.

Around 3:00 AM on October 25, Sharif was allegedly taken out of the flat and forced into a car. He managed to inform a police patrol vehicle near Shishu Hospital in Shyamoli, leading to the arrest of the six individuals and seizure of the car.

After being arrested in the case filed by the businessman with Mohammadpur Police Station, the two DGFI personnel were handed over to the army. They were subsequently tried under military law, resulting in their dismissal and imprisonment.

headline_marked: Free recruitment for [[112 skilled male workers in Malaysia]] via BOESL
headline: Free recruitment for 112 skilled male workers in Malaysia via BOESL
summary: Applications open from Nov 6 to Nov 8 for Operations Assistant and Technical Skill Worker roles at DHL Supply Chain Malaysia.
details: The Bangladesh Overseas Employment and Services Limited (BOESL) is recruiting 112 skilled male workers for employment in Malaysia.
The vacancies are for 'Operations Assistant' and 'Technical Skill Workers' positions at the company 'DHL Supply Chain (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd.'
Selected candidates will receive a basic monthly salary of 1,700 Malaysian Ringgit.
Applicants must be aged between 22 and 35 years. The contract duration is the three years, with a working schedule of eight hours per day, six days a week.
The employer will provide overtime pay, housing, first aid, and transportation facilities.
Applications can be submitted via the official BOESL online link from 10 AM on Friday, November 6, until 4 PM on November 8.
BOESL has explicitly stated that no fees will be charged at any stage of the recruitment process, warning candidates to avoid any financial transactions.
